_comment: EXAMPLE — copy to $CLAUDE_TRIAGE_DIR/settings.json and replace every __PROJECT_ROOT__ with your project's absolute path (e.g. /Users/you/dev/myproject — it begins with a slash). IMPORTANT: in Edit()/Write() rules a single leading slash is PROJECT-relative, so a filesystem-absolute path needs a DOUBLE slash — that is why those rules read `/__PROJECT_ROOT__/**` (the extra slash + your slash-prefixed path = `//...`). A single slash there silently matches nothing and every edit is denied. `additionalDirectories` and `sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite` take the real path (no extra slash). Also replace __CLAUDE_TRIAGE_DIR__ with your $CLAUDE_TRIAGE_DIR (the daemon's config dir, e.g. ~/.claude-triage) — its `session-env` MUST be sandbox-writable or Claude Code fails to create a per-command env dir and EVERY Bash call dies with EPERM. Keeps deny rules, drops the interactive ask rules (which hang headless), runs Bash in the macOS Seatbelt sandbox. Your interactive ~/.claude is untouched.
